title: Correct the unit-tests gate in sdlc/policy.json to name a runner per language
description: Edit company-profile/example-co/sdlc/policy.json ciGates. Keep {gate: unit-tests, tool: vitest, blocking: true} for the TypeScript repos and add {gate: unit-tests, tool: pytest, blocking: true} for Python repos such as onfinance-db-model-master. If the sdlc-policy schema rejects a second unit-tests entry, keep one entry and record the Python runner as a soc observation instead of inventing a field. The ciGates item schema (.claude/schemas/v1/company/sdlc-policy.schema.json) allows only gate, tool, blocking and minSeverityToBlock, so the coverage floors cannot go into policy.json. Record them (the vitest thresholds from task 1, the pytest fail_under from task 3) as a soc observation against sebi-cscrf-2024:PR.IP.S6 with methods [manual] per maxwell-conventions section 6. Merge through a reviewed change with the sdlc policy owner (cto) as reviewer.
acceptanceCriteria: `node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs company-profile/example-co/sdlc/policy.json` exits 0 and ciGates contains a blocking unit-tests gate whose tool is pytest (or, if the schema forbids it, a soc observation exists recording why).

company-profile/example-co/soc/main.jsonl contains an observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:PR.IP.S6 recording the enforced coverage floors for mongodb-mcp-server and onfinance-db-model-master, with evidence pointing at vitest.config.ts and .coveragerc at their merge commits.

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer opens the policy.json diff and the new soc observation line. Expected: validate-data is green, the unit-tests gate names a runner that applies to each repo language, and the observation's recorded coverage floors match the values in the merged vitest.config.ts and .coveragerc.

rootCause.description: The SDLC policy states a single vitest unit-test gate for all repositories, which does not apply to the Python db-models repo and records no coverage expectation, so the claimed gate could not be checked against reality.
